category_title: Third-grade African American students who rely on picture support and skip text when overwhelmed
scenario_title: Oral reading with high word density and picture reliance
minimal_context: Tommy is reading a text with high word density and illustrations aloud during a tutoring session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please read this page out loud for me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the page) That's a lot of words. I'm just going to skip down to this line here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, go ahead and read that part.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Pulled on his, pulled on his shirt and put.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look at the words again. Are you sure it says shirt?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Points confidently to the illustration on the page) Yeah, shirt. You see his shirt?

TUTOR: Please read this page out loud for me.

STUDENT: (Looks at the page) That's a lot of words. I'm just going to skip down to this line here.

TUTOR: Look at the words again. Are you sure it says shirt?

STUDENT: (Points confidently to the illustration on the page) Yeah, shirt. You see his shirt?
